integrity: All public computational evidence is embedded, with source algorithms and a regenerated finite chain certificate. Comparisons to previous records distinguish rational homology invariants from integral orbit-space homotopy. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Finite classification for the ordinary 4-by-4 knight graph under full geometric D4; does not extend to other boards or homeomorphism classification. Exhaustive code-based reductions have not been independently audited. The 2007 date is the independently verified first public arXiv submission date of the principal independence-complex source; the 2000 chessboard reference has only year-level publication evidence.
title: The four-by-four knight symmetry quotient is a three-sphere
